provenance.method: Mixed-neurotype communication question preserving reciprocal misunderstanding and non-diagnostic boundaries.

question: People with different communication styles keep misunderstanding each other. How can we examine the mismatch without deciding one person communicates 'wrong'?
why_it_matters: Communication friction is often framed as an individual deficit even when assumptions, indirectness, processing speed or context differ on both sides.
current_understanding: Describe the mismatch behaviourally: direct versus implied requests, response time, turn-taking, literal versus contextual language, amount of detail and preferred medium. Agree an explicit convention where possible and check understanding rather than inferring motive. ND Oracle should not diagnose the other person from their style.
evidence_needed: Stronger mixed-neurotype communication research beyond autism-only laboratory tasks.
Evidence on communication agreements in workplaces, families and services.
reopening_conditions: New research materially changes the reciprocal-mismatch model.
Reviewed practical resources demonstrate effective cross-style communication methods.
dissent: Reciprocity should not be used to excuse bullying, coercion or refusal to make reasonable access changes.
